data.turoyo: <...> ftəḥlan gəmṯo, ono zqəlli w u taʕlo kəmnabeb.
data.translation: <...> daselbst haben wir uns einen Webstuhl aufgestellt; ich wob, während der Fuchs den Haspel trieb.

rationale: Fills thin Infectum cell with retrospective narration and contrasting completed zqəlli; possible inherited supplementary-citation overlap is queried.

summary: Literal yarn-reeling and figurative being a match are already combined in sense 1, with ʕal iḏ- explicitly included in its gloss. New evidence does not justify changing that inherited numbering.
PrS 77/37 embeds Infectum kəmnabeb in retrospective narration beside completed zqəlli. PrS 77/42 contrasts habitual craft activities in -wo with completed deductions from the yarn.
The fixed ʕal iḏ- frame is already represented at 29/217 in both the gloss and Preterit example; it is not added again under Idiomatic phrases.

Does the supplementary prs 225/27 reference already point to the retrospective PrS 77/37? The expanded quotation is retained for its explicit contrast with zqəlli; editors can merge it if those references coincide.
